findings.label: No on-device check of the orange pin
findings.detail: The backend doesn't send is_plus yet, so the new _buildPin Plus branch has never rendered. Before release, check it on the emulator once with a temporarily forced isPlus: true, or after the backend ships the field.

findings.label: Mixed hunks in api.dart
findings.detail: This task's isPlus hunks sit next to the concurrent search workflow's idsCsv/ozellikler hunks. Use hunk-level staging so each feature can be committed or reverted on its own.

findings.label: Unrelated generated plugin-registrant changes
findings.detail: Files under windows/, linux/ and macos/ changed, most likely from a flutter pub get/build run. Neither feature needs them, so leave them out of the commit or commit them separately.
